generation_notes:
All images should be:
- Commercial license OK (CC0, CC-BY, or MIT equivalent)
- Appropriate for elementary school children aged 10-11
- Using green color scheme (#2ECC71, #27AE60)
- Educational and motivating
- High quality and professional
- No text/watermarks
- Centered compositions where applicable
